cases.notes: Two AndroidManifest.xml entries; the last (binary AXML, UTF-8 pool) wins over an older plain-XML twin. The AXML carries a 200-character package string (two-byte UTF-8 length form), a style-span pool string kept as metadata, an escaped attribute value and CDATA with a ']]>' split. Facts compare the full ordered tree (nodes + rendered XML, which covers text and tails) plus raw typed data and styles.

APK without any manifest entry: the entry scan finds nothing to decode. The A06 contract test pins the boundary fact (no AndroidManifest.xml in the central directory); A07's read_entry-to-Engine wiring surfaces it as the NotFound error kind this case names. The manifest operation never requires a DEX entry to exist or be valid.

A manifest entry that starts like XML text but has an unclosed tag: rejected as MalformedInput instead of the old verbatim passthrough that rendered fake text as a success. Wrongly encoded (non-UTF-8, UTF-16 BOM) variants are pinned in the A06 contract tests alongside this registered input.

A UTF-16-pool AXML with attributes n01..n33 covering every typed value form: app/android references and attributes, string with raw value, float raw bits (2.0, +/-inf, NaN), all six dimension units plus an unknown unit, fractions (% and %p), signed/hex integers including INT_MIN and -1, booleans, the four AOSP colour types, dynamic reference/attribute (0x07/0x08), reserved 0x13, unknown 0x33 and null 0x00. Facts keep the raw type/data numbers beside the formatted value so precision is compared, not just rendered text.

AXML namespace scopes: prefix 'app' bound on the root, shadowed to a second URI on an inner element and restored after it, plus a default-namespace element and namespaced attributes. The android namespace is never declared: the canonical binding is added explicitly with one inferred-namespace-binding warning. Node order keeps two CDATA siblings with their exact text (including the tail-flavoured second one); the namespace end after the root close is consumed as epilog structure. Comments ride as element metadata.

Plain-XML entry parsed into the domain model: prolog/epilog comments, PIs and whitespace in position; mixed content with text before/after child elements (text and tails are ordered Text nodes, compared one by one); CDATA; predefined and numeric character references round-tripped (a newline char reference stays a reference in attributes); an undeclared attribute prefix is kept verbatim rather than guessed. Added by A06 to give the plain-XML tree shape its own pinned facts.

Registered flavor: a second root element after a complete first root. The A06 contract tests additionally pin (without separate inputs) the other structural rejections: unmatched end element/namespace indices, duplicate attributes, truncated documents, trailing bytes past the declared size, unknown node chunk types, out-of-pool string indices and non-XML garbage. A mutation smoke over every fixture returns errors, never panics, in debug and release profiles.

A DOCTYPE declaration (internal or external) is rejected as UnsupportedFormat without any I/O: the reader never opens files, URLs or entity resolvers. Non-UTF-8 declared encodings and XML versions other than 1.0 report unsupported too; unknown entities without a DTD are malformed. These variants are pinned in the A06 contract tests alongside this registered input.

Three nested elements: decoding with a depth limit of two fails with ResourceLimit while the default limits succeed - the boundary is exercised from the exceeding side with a small override. The A06 contract tests sweep the remaining limits (nodes, attributes, string units, output bytes, render depth) the same way, each rejecting on the exceeding side only.
